_about: The walkthrough's words: the film's narrator lines (ids starting f-, tools/film/src/tour, the After Hours film) and one line per step of the guided tour in the site (tour.js). The film array is its beats: a line, an act card, or both, with the silence before (pre) and after (post) in seconds. The narrator describes the site and never speaks as Jason. Every fact is already in llms.txt (most lines are its own sentences about the site, trimmed). No em or en dashes, no percent signs, no numbers that are not in llms.txt. tools/voice/narrate_free.py (Kokoro, free and local; tools/voice/eleven.mjs is the optional ElevenLabs path) reads this file and writes assets/voice/tour/<id>.mp3, <id>.json (word timings) and manifest.json; tools/site/assemble_home.py inlines the lines (and the timings, once they exist) into the home page as #tour-data. Change a line and run sh tools/voice/narrate.sh to re-voice and re-render.

voice.label: Narration: a stock Kokoro voice (open source), not Jason.
voice.caption_only: Captions only. The narration has not been recorded yet.
